name: cc-academia
description: Academic research toolchain — reading the literature, writing manuscripts (LaTeX checks over a layered knowledge base), reviewing your own drafts and others' submissions, and refereeing (reviewer discovery), backed by one deterministic Python library and an accumulating local scholarly database.
